The '''Iron Edge''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained by [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on floors 40-59 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 60 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 4 to 3 and sell price lowered from {{Price|200}} to {{Price|150}}. Bug where weapon defense had no effect fixed.}}
